description: Abstract class for managing multipart uploads in AWS SDK for PHP, handling stream sources, creating upload commands, and managing upload parts.

classes.name: AbstractUploader
classes.description: Abstract class for handling multipart upload logic, including source management and command generation.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the uploader with a client, source, and configuration.

methods.name: limitPartStream
methods.description: Creates a limited stream for a specific upload part.

methods.name: getUploadCommands
methods.description: Generates upload commands for each part of the source.

methods.name: createPart
methods.description: Abstract method to generate parameters for an upload part.

methods.name: isEof
methods.description: Checks if the source has reached EOF.

methods.name: determineSource
methods.description: Converts the source input into a readable stream.

methods.name: getNumberOfParts
methods.description: Calculates total number of parts based on source size and part size.
